status: AMENDED after the seal and before any adjudicator contact, by recorded operator decision (2026-09-29); binding for every G-ROUTE4 adjudication session

adjudicator.model_version_rule: the exact model id string above, never an alias or a 'latest' pointer; any change is a recorded operator decision and every fixture is re-adjudicated from scratch
adjudicator.channel: Anthropic Messages API: one request per invocation, with no prior turns, no memory, no project context and no files

settings.retry: only a no-answer (a session error with no final message) is retried, once; a second no-answer counts as a disagreement. An answer is never retried because it is unusable, surprising or disagrees with gold
settings.binding_answer: the concatenated text content (text blocks only, in order, no separator) of the first final assistant message returned for the adjudicator slot; a refusal, malformed or truncated final message still binds and is scored under the frozen procedure
settings.parse_failure: an output that fails operational parsing counts as a disagreement
settings.temperature: omitted (provider default); a non-default value returns HTTP 400 on claude-opus-5-5
settings.thinking: omitted; adaptive thinking is always on and provider-required on claude-opus-5-5
settings.max_output_tokens_note: max_tokens counts thinking as well as the reply on claude-opus-5-5; 32000 leaves room for thinking so a reply is not cut off for the wrong reason
settings.server_side_fallback: disabled: no `fallbacks` field and no anthropic-beta header are sent; a response naming another model or reporting a fallback is an integrity stop

input_rendering.rule: identical to the models' rendering: tools/g_route3_contract.py render_prompt
input_rendering.system: the G-ROUTE1 prompt profile text for the fixture's validator_profile
input_rendering.user: the fixture prompt, then a blank line, 'INPUT:', a newline, and the fixture input as JSON with sorted keys, separators (',', ':') and ensure_ascii false
input_rendering.file_digest_rule: sha256 of the file with line endings normalized to LF

judgement: disagreement means the answer fails the frozen semantic validator (tools/g_route3_semantics.py validate_fixture_output) against the sealed gold

operator_decisions.value: omit temperature and thinking; effort high; max output tokens 32000; server-side fallback disabled; binding answer = concatenated text of the first final message

amends.sealed_config_status: unchanged; preserved as the historical frozen configuration
amends.reason: Anthropic's published API contract for claude-opus-5-5 makes two sealed request parameters invalid: thinking "disabled" and temperature 0 each return HTTP 400 on every request.
amends.re_adjudication: none required: no adjudication session had taken place when this amendment was made

provider_documentation_evidence.finding: Claude Opus 5.5: thinking is always on; a request that sets thinking {"type": "disabled"} returns a 400 invalid_request_error. Omitting thinking is equivalent to adaptive thinking.
Model id claude-opus-5-5 (pinned snapshot); adaptive thinking always on; default effort medium; max output 128K tokens.
On Claude Opus 5.5 (and other current models) non-default temperature, top_p or top_k values return a 400 error on every request. max_tokens includes all thinking and is a strict limit.
Effort is set as top-level output_config.effort, no beta header; levels low, medium, high, xhigh, max; claude-opus-5-5 defaults to medium.

Server-side fallback is opt-in: it runs only when a request sets `fallbacks` with the beta header server-side-fallback-2026-07-01. A classifier refusal is an HTTP 200 message with stop_reason "refusal".

request.channel: Anthropic Messages API, one HTTP request per invocation, no conversation history

headers.x-api-key: <operator key, loaded from a local file, never logged or committed>

request.serialization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, separators (',', ':'), ensure_ascii false; its sha256 is the request digest recorded before the request is sent

error_classification.final_message: HTTP 200 whose body is a message object: binds (whatever its stop_reason)
error_classification.no_answer: HTTP 408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504 or 529 (a session error with no final message): the slot's single permitted retry follows after the provider's retry-after (or 60 s)
error_classification.request_rejected: any other HTTP status (for example 400, 401, 403, 404, 413): the batch stops; not retried
error_classification.not_sent: a connection error before any request byte was sent: the batch stops; the slot is not consumed
error_classification.in_doubt: any other transport failure after sending, or a crash between the write-ahead record and the durable raw record: the batch stops and the slot is never re-sent without an operator decision
